The problem

Nobody can say what an agent is allowed to do before it does it.

How it works

Two enforcement points. One contract.

Install once per device, once per network. The Control Plane holds the contract; the Runtime and the Gateway enforce it; every decision lands in Evidence, signed.

01Runtime + Gateway — enforce
app.wrapbox.ai · Downloads — Runtime per device · Gateway per network
Runtime — a signed daemon on every laptop and server, MDM-pushed via Jamf / Intune / Kandji. Gateway — one container in front of every MCP server, API and cloud call.
macOSWindowsLinuxClaude CodeCursorCopilot
02Control Plane — govern & prove
Evidence — 28,466 decisions · human → agent → rule → permit → outcome
Every decision with the chain that produced it — filter by agent, human or rule; export to Splunk, Datadog, or an auditor-ready pack. Each one comes back signed with ECDSA P-256, bound to exact arguments, single-use, hash-chained.

Why we're different

Everyone watches. Nobody decides.

Every adjacent category observes one slice of the agent's day. None stands in the execution path and answers yes or no — per action, before it runs, with proof.

categorywhothe blind spot
LLM guardrailsLakera · Prompt Securityjudge the text of prompts and replies — blind to the command that executes
Agent observabilityLangSmith · Langfusetrace what happened — after it ran; can stop nothing
IAM / PAMOkta · CyberArkgrant standing access up front — blind between the grant and the action
EDR / DLPCrowdStrike · Purviewflag artifacts on disk and wire — after the effect, not before the ask
MCP itselfthe transporthands agents their tools — ships with no permission layer
IAM decided what a person may access. Wrapbox decides what an agent may do. That is a new layer, not a feature of an old one.
only wrapbox
Runtime authorization
01Decides the action itself — effect, arguments, context — pre-execution, deterministic, <1 ms. No model in the loop, so no jailbreak moves the answer.
02One contract, two planes — device runtime + network gateway. Covers every vendor; an unknown agent fails closed.
03Every answer is signed — ECDSA permit bound to exact args, single-use; hash-chained receipts an auditor can replay.
04The demanded category — Gartner: by 2028, 40% of CIOs will require “Guardian Agents” to oversee and contain AI-agent actions. That layer is what we ship.

Roadmap

Productionize the Runtime + Gateway, validate them independently, and deploy with real companies across a focused six-month execution window.

Today · prototypeMonth 0Month 3Month 6 · seed
Runtime → production engineering
macOS · Linux · Windows — endpoint hardening, MDM deployment, signed updates, tamper resistance, OS-native enforcement. macOS/Linux first, Windows in parallel.
Gateway → production engineering
MCP · APIs · databases · cloud · SaaS — policy enforcement, credential brokering, identity, approvals, short-lived permits, evidence, integrations.

Product & Engineering
Build the two enforcement layers companies actually deploy.
Endpoint Runtime — productionize wrapboxd across macOS, Linux, Windows: OS-level enforcement, agent discovery, network controls, MDM, signed updates, tamper resistance.
Enforcement Gateway — agent-independent control point for MCP, APIs, DBs, cloud, SaaS: policy eval, credential brokering, approvals, short-lived permits, evidence.
Control Plane — fleet visibility, intent contracts, policies, approvals, incidents, evidence.
Team: Founder/Product + Senior Endpoint Security Eng + Senior Security/Backend Eng.

Design Partners & Enterprise Pilots
Recruit 10 design partners deploying with real employees and agents; convert 3–5 to paid pilots (e.g. 25 devices → Runtime via MDM → Gateway on GitHub + AWS + DB, 60-day pilot). Founder-led sales, onboarding, Jamf/Intune/SIEM integrations.
10%$180K
Security & Compliance
Independent experts attack what enterprises must trust — Runtime bypass, daemon tampering, Gateway bypass, forged/replayed permits, evidence integrity. SOC 2 readiness + Apple ES entitlement path. Goal: evidence customers can evaluate, not a claim.

Infrastructure & Operations
Cloud for Control Plane, Gateway, enrollment, policy distribution, evidence, monitoring, backups. Code signing/notarization, secure releases, legal, insurance, accounting.
